# Launch Forte

> Launch Forte builds and runs the revenue and operations systems a growing business runs on, the CRM, automation, funnels, data foundation, and reporting. Every build runs on The Forte Method (Foundation, Engine, Growth). Founded by Seth Forte, based in Dallas, Texas, serving clients nationwide. Fixed scope, fixed price, fixed timeline.

## Flagship offer
- [One Connected System](https://launchforte.com/one-connected-system): The data foundation build. We pull scattered tools into one clean source of truth, resolve identities so the same person is one record, end manual data entry, and build the foundation reporting and AI run on. Covers single source of truth, data unification, identity resolution, and system of record work.

## Who we build for
- [Coaches and creators](https://launchforte.com/coaches): The CRM and funnel that carry a lead from the first DM to a repeat client.
- [Home and field services](https://launchforte.com/home-services): The system that catches every call and ends the retyping across field tools.
- [Financial and professional firms](https://launchforte.com/financial-firms): Automated invoicing, capital calls, and investor reporting, built with the controls money work demands.
- [Med spas and aesthetic practices](https://launchforte.com/medspa): The patient system, from new patient capture to rebooking and reactivation, on the software you already run.
- [Med spa Patient Reactivation Campaign](https://launchforte.com/medspa/reactivation): A fixed price campaign that brings lapsed patients back in ten days from inside your software.
- [Real estate agents](https://launchforte.com/real-estate): The GoHighLevel system that captures every lead and does the follow up while you are out closing.
